SIMPLE ENGLISH
git worktree lets one repository use multiple checked-out working directories sharing its object
database, with separate working trees and indexes.
සිංහJලෙන් එක repo එකක branches Jදකකේ Jවනම folders වල checkout කර parallel වැඩ කරන්න
Keep feature changes open while fixing a release in another folder.

Shared Git object database · Worktree A: feature + own index Worktree B: hotfix + own index · Read the diagram: Shared object database; Worktree A: feature; Worktree B: hotfix; Separate indexes. · එක repo එකක branches Jදකකේ Jවනම folders වල checkout කර parallel වැඩ කරන්න worktree භාවිත කරන්න · පුළුවන්.

git worktree add -b hotfix/demo ../hotfix main
git worktree list
# After finishing and checking the worktree:
git worktree remove ../hotfix
Expected: A second working directory is created on a new branch; the original remains untouched.

How is worktree different from stash? Worktree creates another checkout; stash temporarily shelves
changes.
